title: Lending an Ear

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Well, you found me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, you found me.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: I haven't actually gone inside yet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I haven't actually gone inside yet.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Ha. You really like this good person act, huh? Regardless, what I meant was, I've yet to go inside at all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha. You really like this good person act, huh? Regardless, what I meant was, I've yet to go inside at all.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: About Tehani? No, I haven't. About you? Consistently.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: About Tehani? No, I haven't. About you? Consistently.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Ugh. Just tell me what you're doing here so we can move on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ugh. Just tell me what you're doing here so we can move on.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: You heard me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You heard me.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Fuckin' honesty, yeah? Tehani was my kid sister. She was my best friend. My confidant. It shoulda been me who took that batch, not her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuckin' honesty, yeah? Tehani was my kid sister. She was my best friend. My confidant. It shoulda been me who took that batch, not her.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: It wasn't the same.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It wasn't the same.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Hahaha, man, you really can't quit with this concerned friend thing can you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hahaha, man, you really can't quit with this concerned friend thing can you?

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Took a Post-Ap trip a little while ago... never thought an alien invasion would make me shit myself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Took a Post-Ap trip a little while ago... never thought an alien invasion would make me shit myself.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Hmph. Sounds like Tehani. That kid was friendly to everyone. I tried to see her through a hit of Post-Ap but just nuclear bombs and burning buildings.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmph. Sounds like Tehani. That kid was friendly to everyone. I tried to see her through a hit of Post-Ap but just nuclear bombs and burning buildings.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Personal experience.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Personal experience.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Pffft. How stupid do you think I am? Idlehands let me borrow a chem-set to test it. Probably was hanging around because it wanted it back. I actually think I'm gonna keep it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pffft. How stupid do you think I am? Idlehands let me borrow a chem-set to test it. Probably was hanging around because it wanted it back. I actually think I'm gonna keep it.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Listen, he might be a little, ugh, squirrely and whatnot, but he's not a bad dude. You know, aside from dealing illegal substances and all that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Listen, he might be a little, ugh, squirrely and whatnot, but he's not a bad dude. You know, aside from dealing illegal substances and all that.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess all I have left to do is go inside. Thanks for everything. Hopefully I'll see you around.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, I guess all I have left to do is go inside. Thanks for everything. Hopefully I'll see you around.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Something tells me you'd like that a little too much. Besides, having some company in front of this place isn't the worst thing I've ever experienced.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Something tells me you'd like that a little too much. Besides, having some company in front of this place isn't the worst thing I've ever experienced.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: But he loved my sister and he's the closest thing I have to her now that she's gone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But he loved my sister and he's the closest thing I have to her now that she's gone.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I did.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I did.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just hanging out here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just hanging out here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Oh, I can wait if you want a few minutes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, I can wait if you want a few minutes.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Oh, I can wait if you want a few minutes.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Oh, I can wait if you want a few minutes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait, what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How come?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How come?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So that's why you haven't talked to Magz in awhile.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So that's why you haven't talked to Magz in awhile.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So that's why you haven't talked to Magz in awhile.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So that's why you haven't talked to Magz in awhile.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Good things I hope.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good things I hope.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's why my ears were ringing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's why my ears were ringing.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's why my ears were ringing.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's why my ears were ringing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's not your fault.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's not your fault.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Idlehands was at your spot. Wanted to make sure you were okay.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Idlehands was at your spot. Wanted to make sure you were okay.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Idlehands was at your spot. Wanted to make sure you were okay.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Idlehands was at your spot. Wanted to make sure you were okay.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What'd you find out about the batch?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What'd you find out about the batch?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What'd you find out about the batch?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What'd you find out about the batch?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How do you know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How do you know?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tell me to leave.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell me to leave.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's a major character flaw I know. I get taken advantage of quite a bit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a major character flaw I know. I get taken advantage of quite a bit.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's a major character flaw I know. I get taken advantage of quite a bit.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's a major character flaw I know. I get taken advantage of quite a bit.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You took it without knowing if the batch was bad?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You took it without knowing if the batch was bad?!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You took it without knowing if the batch was bad?!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You took it without knowing if the batch was bad?!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's why he was there?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's why he was there?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you trust he didn't give Tehani a bad batch?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you trust he didn't give Tehani a bad batch?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And you trust he didn't give Tehani a bad batch?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And you trust he didn't give Tehani a bad batch?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You still have her marker.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You still have her marker.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I get that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I get that.
